config.label: SearchApi API key
config.description: SearchApi API key. Required only for SearchApi primary or fallback modes.

config.label: Provider for search and search_parallel: browser, searchapi, or fallback
config.description: Provider for search and search_parallel: browser, searchapi, or fallback. Defaults to browser.

config.label: Provider for scholar_search: browser, searchapi, or fallback
config.description: Provider for scholar_search: browser, searchapi, or fallback. Defaults to browser.

config.label: Browser engine: auto, native, or playwright
config.description: Browser engine: auto, native, or playwright. Auto uses one hidden native Chrome broker shared across local MCP sessions.

config.label: Absolute path to the Chrome binary
config.description: Absolute path to the Chrome binary. Auto-detected on Windows/macOS/Linux when omitted.

config.label: Directory for the warm Chrome profile
config.description: Directory for the warm Chrome profile. Defaults to ~/.google-surf-mcp.

config.label: Enable local project memory and hybrid retrieval
config.description: Enable local project memory and hybrid retrieval. Defaults to true.

config.label: Shared route for search and search_parallel: live or hybrid
config.description: Shared route for search and search_parallel: live or hybrid. Defaults to hybrid.

config.label: Embedded SurrealDB data directory
config.description: Embedded SurrealDB data directory. Defaults to <profile>/research.

config.label: Local model for HNSW retrieval and shared reranking
config.description: Local model for HNSW retrieval and shared reranking. Defaults to Xenova/multilingual-e5-small; use off to disable.

config.label: Disable ONNX CPU memory arena and memory pattern
config.description: Disable ONNX CPU memory arena and memory pattern. Defaults to true.

config.label: ONNX intra-op thread count from 1 to 16
config.description: ONNX intra-op thread count from 1 to 16. Defaults to 4.

config.label: Sparse-index at most one eligible small GitHub repository per search call
config.description: Sparse-index at most one eligible small GitHub repository per search call. Defaults to true.

config.label: Maximum searchable repository source-text size in MB
config.description: Maximum searchable repository source-text size in MB. Assets are excluded. Defaults to 20.

config.label: Maximum repository source file count for automatic indexing
config.description: Maximum repository source file count for automatic indexing. Defaults to 2000.

config.label: Shared research broker idle lifetime in milliseconds
config.description: Shared research broker idle lifetime in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

config.label: Maximum concurrent research broker reads
config.description: Maximum concurrent research broker reads. Defaults to 4.

config.label: Timeout per embedded SurrealDB query in milliseconds
config.description: Timeout per embedded SurrealDB query in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000; timed-out retrieval lanes are reported as partial.

config.label: Optional token that raises GitHub API limits for repository inspection
config.description: Optional token that raises GitHub API limits for repository inspection.

config.label: Browser locale, e
config.description: Browser locale, e.g. en-US.

config.label: IANA timezone, e
config.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to system timezone.

config.label: Controls Playwright extraction, compatibility, and recovery paths
config.description: Controls Playwright extraction, compatibility, and recovery paths. Native search hides normal system Chrome and shows it only for CAPTCHA recovery.

config.label: Idle ms before closing the sequential ctx and pool
config.description: Idle ms before closing the sequential ctx and pool. 0 disables idle auto-close. Defaults to 30000.

config.label: Set to 'true' to allow extract on private/loopback addresses (localhost, 10
config.description: Set to 'true' to allow extract on private/loopback addresses (localhost, 10.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x, etc). Default blocks them as an SSRF guard.

config.label: Enable the optional workflow-only LLM selector repair path
config.description: Enable the optional workflow-only LLM selector repair path. Defaults to false.

config.label: LLM selector repair provider: anthropic or orcarouter
config.description: LLM selector repair provider: anthropic or orcarouter. Defaults to anthropic.

config.label: Optional model override
config.description: Optional model override. OrcaRouter defaults to orcarouter/auto.

config.label: Anthropic API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair
config.description: Anthropic API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair.

config.label: OrcaRouter API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair
config.description: OrcaRouter API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair.
